G5103.name: Titus
G5103.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G5103.brief: Gentile convert and companion of Paul
G5103.short: Titus was a Gentile convert and a trusted companion of Paul, who accompanied him on missionary journeys and served as his delegate to the church in Corinth.

G5161.name: Trophimus
G5161.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G5161.brief: Gentile Christian from Ephesus, companion of Paul
G5161.short: Trophimus was a Gentile Christian from Ephesus who accompanied Paul on his missionary journeys and was falsely accused of defiling the temple in Jerusalem.

G5170.name: Tryphaena
G5170.desc: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
G5170.brief: Christian woman in Rome greeted by Paul
G5170.short: Tryphaena was a Christian woman in Rome to whom Paul sent greetings in his letter to the Romans.

G5173.name: Tryphosa
G5173.desc: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
G5173.brief: Christian woman in Rome greeted by Paul
G5173.short: Tryphosa was a Christian woman in Rome to whom Paul sent greetings in his letter to the Romans.

G5190.name: Tychicus
G5190.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G5190.brief: Faithful companion and messenger of Paul
G5190.short: Tychicus was a faithful companion of Paul who served as his messenger to the churches in Asia Minor.

G5181.name: Tyrannus
G5181.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G5181.brief: Ephesian teacher who hosted Paul's discussions
G5181.short: Tyrannus was a teacher in Ephesus who allowed Paul to use his lecture hall for daily discussions about the gospel.

G5140.name: Three Taverns
G5140.brief: Staging post on the Appian Way near Rome
G5140.short: Three Taverns, a staging post on the Appian Way, about 33 miles from Rome, where Paul was met by Roman Christians (<ref="Act.28.15">Act.28.15</ref>).

G5139.name: Trachonitis
G5139.brief: A rugged region northeast of the Jordan River
G5139.short: Trachonitis, a rugged, rocky region northeast of the Jordan River, part of Philip's tetrarchy during the time of John the Baptist (<ref="Luke 3:1">Luke 3:1</ref>).

G5174.name: Troas
G5174.brief: A city in Asia Minor, visited by Paul
G5174.short: Troas, a city in Asia Minor, where Paul had a vision of a man urging him to come to Macedonia, and where he later preached and raised Eutychus from the dead (<ref="Act.16.8-11; 20:5-12; 2Cor. 2:12; 2Tim. 4:13">Act.16.8-11; 20:5-12; 2Cor. 2:12; 2Tim. 4:13</ref>).
G5174.meaning: “the Troad,” the region of ancient Troy

G5175.name: Trogyllium
G5175.brief: A city near Ephesus, visited by Paul
G5175.short: Trogyllium, a coastal town near Ephesus, where Paul's ship anchored during his journey to Jerusalem (<ref="Act.20.15">Act.20.15</ref>).
